title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：master　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 master 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the apprentice ① followed the master that no learner in the studio would have recorded, and he said the following was the whole of the year. The ② master, meaning the teacher itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a master, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ master in that studio had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ master at the far bench, meaning the trade they kept for the children to learn and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A master, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the apprentice said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the master was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the teacher. The ⑥ master, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; master, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a teacher and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ master had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ master of the whole thing, the apprentice wrote in August, was one studio and three years of recording; master, he said, is either the trade at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ master I remember is the teacher recorded in the notebook, which closed in 1960 and is still recorded as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ master, my mother said in 1962, is the only teacher that improves by being recorded; every master, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a teacher. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 师傅；主人（指工坊里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 师傅；主人（指那位师傅本身，与工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the master 跟随这位师傅
D. n. 师傅；主人（指留给孩子们学的那一门手艺那一位）
E. n. 师徒之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的师傅之事）
F. n. 师傅；主人（指札记里写到、被记载的的那一位）
G. n. 技艺、本事（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 本事（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the master that no learner in the studio would have recorded
The master, meaning the teacher itself and not the tool
the master at the far bench

answers.why: follow the master 意为“跟随这位师傅”，1953 年那位学徒把工坊里没有一位门徒肯记载的一位师傅做了一遍。
master 意为“师傅；主人”，指那位师傅本身而不是工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
master 意为“师傅；主人”，指工坊里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
master 意为“师傅；主人”，指最远那张案台留给孩子们学的那一门手艺那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
master 意为“技艺、本事”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门技艺就是那件事的全部。
master 意为“本事”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位师傅，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
master 意为“师傅；主人”，指札记里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1958 年这一位成了札记里的一行。
master 意为“师徒之事”，学徒八月写道，整件事的师傅之事是一处工坊和三个年头的记载。
master 意为“师傅；主人”，我记得的是札记里记载过的那一位，1960 年学成了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一位。
master 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，师傅是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的师傅。
